system.description:
• Effect: Choose one invocation from the list below. Choose another at 6th and 13th level. You cannot take the same invocation twice.
  • Repelling Blast: a creature of Large size or smaller hit by a blast is pushed 10ft.
  • Armour of Shadows: +2 AC while you wear no armour and carry no shield (+3 from 10th level). Does not stack with Bracers of Defence or Mage Armour.
  • Fiendish Vigour: after each full rest you gain temporary hit points equal to your Warlock level.
  • Mask of Many Faces: cast Change Self at will.
  • Devil's Sight: see normally in darkness, magical or otherwise, to 60ft.
